zh: 你有没有在哪儿瞧见我的眼镜？

text: May I help you with something else?
zh: 还有什么我能帮忙的吗？

text: Do you have something to sell?
Can you show me how to mix potions?
zh: 你能教我怎么调配药水吗？

text: Peep around and you'll straight up see I'm a herbalist.
zh: 你四下瞅瞅就明白了，我是个草药师。

text:
Sure.
I'm slowly runnin' out of herbs.
zh:
当然有。
我的草药快见底了。

text: I wanna go out and hunt for some myself, but my eyes ain't what they used to be.
zh: 我倒想自己出去采点，可我这双眼睛不比当年喽。

text: Can ya get me some herbs?
zh: 你能帮我弄点草药来不？

text: I reckon ten plants will do me for now.
zh: 我估摸着十株植物暂时就够用了。

text: Where can I find the herbs?
Awesome! Just hit me up with some if you got any.
zh: 太好了！弄到了就随时来找我。

text:
For real, all over the place.
You'll likely spot most of them in the woods.
zh:
说真的，到处都是。
大部分你多半能在林子里瞧见。

text:
It doesn't matter.
I can mess with all sorts of herbs and plants for my studies.
zh:
无所谓。
各种草药和植物我都能拿来做研究。

text:
But I prefer the rare things.
Something like Brightleaves or Nightvines would be ideal.
zh:
不过我更喜欢稀罕玩意儿。
亮叶草或者夜藤那样的就最理想了。

text: That sucks. Just come back if you rethink it.
zh: 真扫兴。改主意了就再回来吧。

text: Any other herb you wanna give me?
zh: 还有别的草药要给我不？

text: If it was my call, you'd be accepted at the academy.
zh: 要是我说了算，学院早就收你了。
我一定跟瓦拉克说一声。

text:
Nah, I don't think so.
In the end you'll most likely poison yaself.
zh:
不，还是算了吧。
到头来你八成会把自己毒倒。

text:
Just bring me the blueprint and the materials.
I can craft the potions for you instead.
zh:
把配方图和材料带来给我就行。
我可以替你把药水做出来。

text: Then let's heat up the burner.
zh: 那咱们就把炉子烧起来吧。

text:
Look at that!
That's a rare lil plant you got there.
zh:
瞧瞧这个！
你手里这小家伙可是株稀罕植物。

text:
Yeah, sure.
I can show you how to easily find the plants in nature.
zh:
行啊，没问题。
我可以教你怎么在野外轻松找到植物。

text:
People think the plants won't grow back.
But if you know better, you'll always spot somethin'.
zh:
人们总以为植物不会再长出来。
可你要是懂行，就总能有所发现。

text:
Well, it's actually quite simple. Plants always grow back.
It's best to look around carefully each time to see if you can spot another plant.
zh:
嗯，其实很简单。植物总会重新长出来。
每次最好都仔细四处看看，说不定又能发现一株。

text: It also helps to know what the plants look like, though.
zh: 当然，认得植物长什么样也很有用。
